reason_for_change: Adds a two-mana instant that copies the next instant/sorcery and has flashback; can copy Brain Freeze, rituals or tutors, complementing the deck’s spell-chain plan.
commander_identity_rationale: Reinforces Cormela’s instant/sorcery focus and graveyard recursion without replacing the commander’s own mana/death trigger engine.
role_impact: More flexible spell-copy line; Grapeshot’s direct-damage storm finish and utility removal are lost.
power_level_impact: Optimization within cEDH ceiling; qualitative gain in flexibility, not a tested win-rate claim.

power_level_impact: Deliberate trade-off, not unconditional superiority; no matched-game result.
